results.title: Manchester Exchange railway station
results.text: Manchester Exchange railway station was a railway station located in Salford, immediately to the north of Manchester city centre. It served the city between 1884 and 1969. The main approach road ran from the end of Deansgate near Manchester Cathedral, passing over the River Irwell and Chapel Street; a second approach road led up from Blackfriars Road. Despite its name, the station was located just over the Manchester/Salford boundary (River Irwell) in Salford, and only the 1929 extension to Platform 3 was east of the Irwell in Manchester.
